projects.name: Modernize Bhutan’s border management ecosystem to facilitate the safe trade of agri-food product
projects.description:
This is a three-year project (2025-2027) funded by the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) of the World Trade Organization (WTO). The International Trade Centre (ITC) will serve as the implementing partner, ensuring effective coordination and execution of project activities in close partnership with Bhutan Food and Drug Authority (BFDA).

The project aims to address challenges faced by the Royal Government of Bhutan in ensuring the efficiency and safety of cross-border trade in agricultural and food products, including limited capacity for implementing SPS measures and border inspections, unpredictable trade requirements, lack of coordination among regulatory agencies, delays due to non-recognition of Bhutan’s certificates, and weak infrastructure for testing and certification. This project supports Bhutan in overcoming these challenges by leveraging solutions at the intersection of trade facilitation, border management, and quality compliance.
